desc_en: True sophistication begins from the first layer. This exclusive piece is meticulously designed for the woman seeking discreet luxury. Against a powdery pink background, an absolute black heraldic emblem unfolds. Precision pattern making respects natural body shapes. Crafted entirely from high-density cotton with a technical weight of 190 g/m². Made-to-order pieces with worldwide shipping.
